_doc: The Vos Syndicate's line in the game (mockup 37, change vos-ship-concepts, task 2.5; owner, 2026-11-11: "I woudl cut number 12 out (ram) , everything else is good to go, implmenet it"). It replaces the placeholder Vos line of mockup 36. Read by tools/factions/placeholder_classes.py, which writes each class into data/battle/classes.json, data/campaign/campaign.json and the systems files the way it writes a placeholder line: a class copies the battle numbers of its template class, at its true length times the battle framing (2.7), with these changes. length_m: the true length, metres, measured from the bake (assets/ships/vos/manifest.json). hull_x: the template's hull points times this (the Vos fly a weaker hull than a warship of their size: design D11). power_e: allocations that replace the template's. mines and fighters: the ship's load (data/battle/systems/tractor.json loadouts). marines: the marines aboard (data/battle/systems/cloak.json). Each ship has one trade (design D12); the trades the game has no system for yet (rock breaking was the Ram's, cut; the disguise, task 2.4) are not played. Names are the mockup's and provisional; the culture is the owner's (survey U7).
name: Vos Syndicate

classes.name: Drum
classes.why: Twelve containers round its spine are mine racks: it sows a field as it runs

classes.name: Cross
classes.why: Four arms with a tractor emitter at each tip hold a ship fast

classes.name: Boarder
classes.why: A welded grapple fork holds the prize while its crews go aboard

classes.name: Broadside
classes.why: Passes as a freighter: eight containers on its flanks are gun houses

classes.name: Deck runner
classes.why: A flight deck over its drive block carries six Cutters, the Syndicate's own fighters
